concept: Sections that open and close under real headings, separated by the etched groove, with a chevron that turns and content that settles in.

default_to_avoid.pattern: grey header bars with a plus sign and a border round each panel (Bootstrap accordion)
default_to_avoid.why_not: grey bars and borders box every section and read as a table

derivation.consequence: light falls from above, so every surface carries a rim brightest along its top edge and a soft shadow below that says where it floats, and a recess is the inverse, shaded under its top lip and lit on its bottom lip; a nested surface adds no second blur, because one sheet of glass is one layer
derivation.form: the etched groove of Divider between sections, nothing boxed

derivation.consequence: long ease-out curves (420 to 640ms) for arriving and hovering, a shorter one (200ms) for pressing because a press is a reply; under reduced motion every duration is zero at the token level
derivation.form: content eases open at entry pace and opens at once under reduced motion

derivation.consequence: keyboard reaches everything a pointer can, with a visible focus ring on any backdrop
derivation.form: each title is a heading and a 44px button that says whether it is open

variants.reason: A keeps the page a page. B boxes it. C makes each answer a separate object.

root.why: the sections one under another, the same in every theme and on every scene

item.why: a section with the groove above it, the same in every theme and on every scene

heading.why: the section title is a real heading, the same in every theme and on every scene

trigger.why: the heading’s button, a 44px row, the same in every theme and on every scene

chevron.why: a chevron that turns when the section opens

content.why: the content that eases open, the same in every theme and on every scene

inner.why: the content in the body size, the same in every theme and on every scene

focus-visible.why: the shared focus ring on the heading, the same in every theme and on every scene

data-disabled.why: a disabled section uses the disabled opacity, the same in every theme and on every scene

data-state=open.why: an open section’s chevron turns and its content shows

data-state=closed.why: a closing section eases shut, the same in every theme and on every scene

hover.why: a pointer gets a wash before the press so the target shows its size; only where the device can hover, so a tap never leaves it stuck

@media hover: hover.why: hover styles apply only on devices that can hover, so a touch screen never shows a stuck wash after a tap

@media forced-colors: active.why: in forced colours the system draws the link, the current page and the focus ring so every part stays findable

rotate.why: the chevron turns at hover pace, the same in every theme and on every scene

@open.why: the content eases open, the same in every theme and on every scene

@close.why: the content eases shut, the same in every theme and on every scene
